mode_rationale: Built by the orchestrator from claims files and prior full-text findings rather than by re-reading source bodies, per the S1d context-discipline constraint. Each fight cluster is anchored to note IDs so a critic can verify it against source text.

fight_clusters.title: Does iterative feedback help or hurt LLM-guided architecture search?

side_b.position: Iteration fails to improve, or degrades

fight_clusters.note: The likely resolution is that the two sides differ in MECHANISM (external/proxy-scored/evolutionary vs intrinsic sequential refinement on a scalar), not in fact. L1 must test that rather than assume it.

fight_clusters.title: Does quantisation collapse generation diversity?

side_a.position: 4-bit quantisation reduces lexical and syntactic diversity, worse at small scale

side_b.position: Quantisation noise INCREASES sampling entropy; 4-bit degradation is mild, collapse is a 2-bit phenomenon

fight_clusters.note: Genuine unresolved disagreement in the literature. Any claim here must be stated as contested. The magnitude asymmetry - partial vs total - is what makes this decidable for the subject paper.

fight_clusters.title: Are zero-cost proxies a trustworthy search signal?

side_a.position: Zero-cost proxies are a usable refinement signal

side_b.position: Few of 13 proxies generalise; synflow correlates 0.57 with architecture size

fight_clusters.note: Directly checkable from full text on both sides. L5 resolves it.

fight_clusters.title: Is self-correction failure a property of the method or of model scale?

side_a.position: Intrinsic self-correction fails as such, without external verification

side_b.position: The failure is scale-dependent - the generation-verification gap scales with pretraining FLOPs; error LOCATION, not correction, is the bottleneck

fight_clusters.note: Bears on whether a small-model demonstration is confirmatory or novel. If the failure is scale-predictable, observing it at 1.7B adds little.

fight_clusters.title: Mean-of-population vs expected-best-of-k as the estimand for a fixed budget

side_b.position: Population statistics with significance testing are the reporting norm in practice

fight_clusters.note: Not a true contradiction so much as a mismatch between what is reported and what the task requires. Decisive for the subject paper, whose headline inverts under best-of-k.

consensus_claims.claim: Random search is a mandatory and surprisingly strong NAS baseline; many published NAS methods do not beat it convincingly.
Self-correction succeeds when feedback is external, executable, or otherwise grounded, and fails when it is intrinsic.
consensus_claims.confidence: high - 5 independent sources, and no source in the corpus contradicts it

consensus_claims.claim: Single-seed, point-estimate comparisons are inadequate for ranking methods under stochastic training.
Near-identical generation is a documented decoding-procedure artifact, independent of any feedback mechanism.
